title: Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 — Section 63
text: Section 63 of the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 governs the admissibility of electronic or digital records as evidence. It provides that any information contained in an electronic record which is printed, stored, recorded or copied shall be deemed a document, and shall be admissible in evidence without further proof of the original, subject to satisfaction of the conditions specified in the section — including identification of the electronic record, the manner of its production, and the device involved, supported by a certificate (commonly referred to as a Section 63 certificate, successor to the earlier Section 65B certificate under the Indian Evidence Act, 1872) identifying the record and describing the manner of its production, signed by a person occupying a responsible official position in relation to the operation of the relevant device.
